title: Invoke external scripts from YAML jobs
summary: When a YAML execution job uses a standalone script, keep the YAML focused on invoking the script file from its confirmed project path instead of embedding the script body in YAML commands.
statement: When a YAML execution job uses a standalone script, keep the YAML focused on invoking the script file from its confirmed project path instead of embedding the script body in YAML commands.

conditions: Job targets an existing explicitly authorized local repository.
exceptions: Does not authorize changing unrelated or substitute repositories.
